text: Assumption: The strict separation into non-copyable accessor instances primarily serves to deterministically prevent concurrent write conflicts at the operating system level in addition to providing type safety — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The strict separation into non-copyable accessor instances primarily serves to deterministically prevent concurrent write conflicts at the operating system level in addition to providing type safety — is this correct?
norm: the strict separation into non copyable accessor instances primarily serves to deterministically prevent concurrent write conflicts at the operating system level in addition to providing type safety
assumption: The strict separation into non-copyable accessor instances primarily serves to deterministically prevent concurrent write conflicts at the operating system level in addition to providing type safety.
rationale: In the payload, accessors have no copy or move operators, and the API acknowledges concurrent write or erase calls with kResourceBusy.

original.text: Annahme: Interpretation: Die strikte Trennung in unkopierbare Accessor-Instanzen dürfte neben der Typsicherheit primär dazu dienen, konkurrierende Schreibkonflikte auf Betriebssystemebene deterministisch zu verhindern — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Interpretation: Die strikte Trennung in unkopierbare Accessor-Instanzen dürfte neben der Typsicherheit primär dazu dienen, konkurrierende Schreibkonflikte auf Betriebssystemebene deterministisch zu verhindern.
original.rationale: Im Payload besitzen Accessoren keine Copy- oder Move-Operatoren und parallele Schreib- oder Löschaufrufe quittiert die API mit kResourceBusy.
